text:
Fiona (People Ops): Morning! Orientation is scheduled tomorrow 9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM GMT. I pushed invites to new-hires and added the Zoom link + pre-reads.
Kei: Thanks Fiona. My calendar is showing the event but no attachment — could you paste the pre-read links here too? Some clients hide attachments.
Fiona (People Ops): Sure — pre-reads: https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding-pre-reads and access checklist: https://intranet.company.com/onboarding/checklist. I'll also paste them into the event description again.
Marco: Quick timezone check - I'm CET, 9:00 AM PT should be 6:00 PM CET, right?
Ameera: Yes Marco, 9:00 AM PT = 6:00 PM CET.
Marco: Thanks. Also my Google Calendar added a Meet link by default and it conflicts with the Zoom one. Anyone else see duplicate links?
Fiona (People Ops): We've had that issue. Please ignore the Meet link — the Zoom in the event description is the official join link. I'll update the event title to include "(Zoom)" so it's clearer.
Kei: Would it be possible to enable captions and upload a transcript? I rely on captions for clarity.
Fiona (People Ops): We'll enable Zoom auto-captions. After the meeting we'll upload the recording + a transcript and add timestamps for sections.
Ameera: Can we get the recording split into short clips or have jump-to timestamps for setup / security / benefits? Makes follow-up easier.
Fiona (People Ops): Good idea — we'll add timestamps in Notion and also paste them in the calendar description.
Marco: If someone in APAC can't join live, will there be a separate APAC-friendly live session or just the recording?
Fiona (People Ops): We'll host a live APAC-friendly repeat next Wednesday at 8:00 AM PT / 8:30 PM IST. It's a shorter run-through + live Q&A. I'll create a second event labelled "APAC-friendly orientation" and invite the same group.
IT-bot: Reminder: please complete SSO and MFA before orientation to avoid access issues. VPN access is not required for the session but needed for some internal tools post-orientation. Guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/onboarding
Kei: If someone needs an .ics for Outlook or a direct calendar in a different timezone, can you attach one? My manager uses Outlook and it wanted a separate .ics.
calendar-bot: Reply with `ics me` in thread and I will DM the .ics file.
Ameera: One more ask  could you include onboarding buddy names and Slack handles in the calendar description? Easier to know who to ping after the session.
Fiona (People Ops): Yes, adding buddy assignments + Slack handles to the event description now. I'll also pin the Notion page and the recording link in #new-hires-notes after the session.
Marco: Great, thanks everyone. I'll accept the APAC event when it's up.
Fiona (People Ops): I'll post the APAC invite and the Notion link in this thread once live. If anyone doesn't receive invites or sees wrong timezone conversions, DM me and I'll send a direct invite in your local TZ. Reminder email will go out 1 hour before with the checklist.
Kei: Appreciate it ":thumbsup:"
Fiona (People Ops): See you tomorrow (or on the APAC session)!
